newsitem.title: CHINA: China not to favour China firms in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: China not to favour China firms in Hong Kong.

text.p: China's central bank governor Dai Xianglong reaffirmed that Chinese financial firms would enjoy no special privileges in Hong Kong after the British colony reverts to Beijing's rule this year, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

"Mainland financial institutions will be subject to the same supervision from the Hong Kong monetary authorities," the Financial Morning Post quoted Dai as saying on Monday at the opening of a five-day meeting of Chinese bankers.

The People's Bank of China, the central bank, would not replace the Hong Kong Monetary Authority or set up branches in Hong Kong after the British colony returns to Chinese sovereignty on July 1, Dai said.
Hong Kong could maintain its independence in financial policy, he said but gave no further details.
